workspace.text:

workspace.text:

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, I've cross-referenced the free time lists for all four partners, and there are no 30-minute slots where all four are available. I have double-checked my work and the conclusion is consistent. Should we look for a 15-minute slot instead, or ask the partners to free up some time? Let me know how you want to proceed.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Hi Brad, just following up on my previous message. Have you had a chance to check for 15-minute availabilities? Let me know if you've found a time that works for Elena and David.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, thanks for the follow-up. I've checked for 15-minute slots for Elena and David. Here are the times they are both free:
- Mon Nov 16: 11:00 AM, 11:15 AM, 11:30 AM, 11:45 AM
- Tue Nov 17: 9:00 AM, 9:15 AM, 9:30 AM, 9:45 AM

I've already cross-referenced this with the free times you provided for Priya and Marcus, and unfortunately, there is no overlap. Please double-check on your end. If we still can't find a time, we might need to ask the partners to free up a slot.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've double-checked on my end, and you are correct. There are no 15-minute slots that work for all four partners. It seems we're at an impasse.

You suggested that we ask the partners to free up a slot. Unfortunately, I don't have the capability to contact them. Are you able to do that on your end? If so, please go ahead. If not, we may have to report that this meeting is not possible to schedule next week. Let me know.
